summary: getOrder discards authenticated uid — IDOR on detail route
claim: GET /orders/:id must only return orders owned by the caller.
expected: getOrder(id, uid) returns null (or 403) when order.userId !== uid.
observed: function getOrder(id, _uid) { return orders.get(id) ?? null; } — uid unused; any authenticated caller can fetch ord-2.
details: Verify stage used read_file + search. Ownership filter exists on listOrders but not on getOrder.
